caption: The drawing depicts a brass door knocker as the primary object, centered and rendered in color with shades of brass and patina, showing hues of gold, green, and blue oxidation. The main component is a symmetrical, ornate knocker with a pointed finial at the top, a wide central section, and a curved, elongated handle that forms a semi-oval shape, attached to the central block on both sides. Surrounding the central colored depiction are two line drawings in black and white: one to the upper left showing the side profile of the knocker with fastening screws visible, and one to the upper right illustrating a front view of the door knocker and its mounting plate, both scaled to half the size of the actual object (1/2"=1'); the central color drawing is labeled "actual size." The background consists of an off-white, lightly textured surface, framed with simple lines demarcating each section; the artist's signature "A. Walser" is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Door Knocker
